items.subject: Prompt Injection Vulnerability in Ollama, Gemma4 and HuggingFace's Transformers
items.what_happened: A community report describes a prompt injection vulnerability affecting Ollama, the Gemma4 model, and HuggingFace Transformers. Operators running these components in self-hosted inference stacks should review the report and validate untrusted input handling in their serving paths; the claim is from a Reddit post and has not been confirmed by a vendor advisory.

items.rationale: Assess exposure before the next upgrade window
